events.verdict: Irving (BOS) makes incidental foot to foot contact with Lowry (TOR) on the end of the drive.
Morris (BOS) makes marginal contact to the body of Ibaka (TOR) during his shooting motion.
LLB shows Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact to the arm of Siakam (TOR) after he gains possession of the rebound but the contact does not cause Siakam to lose control of the ball.
Siakam (TOR) maintains a legal pivot foot.
[Observable in enhanced video] Leonard (TOR) splits his feet.
LAR and LLS show Tatum (BOS) makes contact to the arm of Leonard (TOR) and the contact affects his ability to gather the ball.
The Raptors commit a 24 second violation.
Siakam (TOR) and Morris (BOS) engage and separate as during the pick.
Leonard (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Irving (BOS).
Ibaka (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Morris (BOS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Green (TOR) slides his pivot foot.
LLB shows Ibaka (TOR) briefly grasps the jersey of Morris (BOS) during the rebound but does not dislodge him or affect his ability to go after the rebound.
Green (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact from Irving (BOS) during the drive.
RLS shows Ibaka (TOR) makes contact to the head of Horford (BOS) on the play at the basket.
Morris (BOS) and Siakam (TOR) engage and separate on the slipped pick.
Smart (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Leonard (TOR).
Siakam (TOR) places a resting hand to the body of Horford (BOS) during his shooting motion but does not deliver contact.
Smart (BOS) is not in a legal guarding position when he makes contact to the body of Lowry (TOR) on the drive that affects his SQBR.
Smart (BOS) moves laterally slightly into the path of Leonard (TOR) during the drive but the contact is marginal and does not affect Leonard's SQBR.
Irving (BOS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Tatum (BOS) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Green (TOR) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Horford (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Siakam (TOR).
[Observable in enhanced video] Irving (BOS) splits his feet.
